HTC Solutions LTD.note: The company operates independently under its HaulTech brand providing transport management systems.

KONEXIT FLEET LTD.note: The company operates independently providing telematics and paperless workforce software.

Macfleet Ltd.note: The company operates independently providing vehicle tracking and telematics solutions.

Multifleet Vehicle Management Ltd.note: The company continues to operate independently under its runyourfleet trading brand.

Orbis IO Ltd.note: The company is operated by Covase Ltd as its fleet intelligence platform provider.

Prolius Ltd.note: The company operates independently as an enterprise fleet management SaaS platform.

Risk Technology Ltd.note: The company operates independently under the Matrix Telematics brand.

Simplicity Group.note: The company operates independently providing connected fleet technology and vehicle CCTV solutions.

TRAC360 LTD.note: The company operates independently offering GPS asset and vehicle tracking hardware and software.

The Miles Consultancy Limited.note: The company operates independently and acquired its competitor Vertivia Holdings Limited in 2020.

Trackit247 Limited.note: Trackit247 Limited remains an active, independent company primarily controlled by J2S Associates Limited with new director appointments in 2026.
